stabled.menu.subtitle: for Minecraft: Java Edition
stabled.settings.title: Stabled Settings
stabled.settings.autosave: Changes are saved to this Save as you make them.
stabled.intro.title: Welcome to Stabled
stabled.intro.done: That's everything. Choose Finish to continue to the main menu. You can change any of this later in Stabled Settings.
stabled.page.appearance.summary: Pick a pre-theme or one of the basic themes, and how surfaces look.
stabled.page.performance.summary: Choose a preset. Changes apply immediately unless marked otherwise.
stabled.page.fps.summary: Show the game's measured frame rate in a corner of the screen.
stabled.page.motion_blur.summary: Smooths fast camera movement by blending recent frames.
stabled.page.discord.summary: Show what you are doing in Minecraft on your Discord profile.
stabled.page.menus.summary: Stabled menu styling and the first-launch introduction.
stabled.themes.pre.desc: Backgrounds that come with Stabled. Pick a category, then a background.
stabled.gallery.unavailable: Pre-themes come with the Stabled launcher. Start this Save from Stabled to use them.
stabled.theme.custom_missing: No custom image yet. Add one in the Stabled launcher (Settings → Appearance → Custom Background). Until then Stabled Night colours are used.
stabled.surface.heading: Surface style
stabled.surface.simple.desc: Solid, opaque panels and buttons with minimal effects. Your glass transparency is kept for later.
stabled.surface.glass.desc: Translucent panels and buttons with a restrained blur behind menus. Higher transparency shows more of the background.
stabled.appearance.global: Theme and surface style are global: they apply to the Stabled launcher and to every Save.
stabled.preset.heading: Preset
stabled.preset.performance.desc: Fast graphics, 8-chunk render distance and 6-chunk simulation distance. Best for low-end PCs and laptops.
stabled.preset.balanced.desc: Fancy graphics with a 12-chunk render distance and 8-chunk simulation distance. A good default for most PCs.
stabled.preset.quality.desc: Fancy graphics with a 16-chunk render distance and 12-chunk simulation distance.
stabled.preset.custom.desc: Stabled leaves your video settings exactly as you set them in Options.
stabled.graphics_api.heading: Graphics API
stabled.graphics_api.restart: Changing the graphics API takes effect after you restart the game. Everything else on this page applies immediately.
stabled.performance.immediate: Everything on this page applies immediately.
stabled.performance.mods: Sodium, Lithium and the other performance mods installed by Stabled are always active. Their own options are under Options → Video Settings.
stabled.fps.preview_label: Positioning preview. The number shown is this menu's live frame rate, not a gameplay measurement.
stabled.fps.measure: In game, the counter shows the renderer's own count of frames in the last second (the same value as the debug screen). It hides while the debug screen is open and when the HUD is hidden (F1).
stabled.motion_blur.cost: Adds one full-screen pass and two screen-sized buffers each frame. Usually a small cost on dedicated graphics; on integrated graphics at high resolutions it can lower FPS noticeably. Buffers are released when motion blur is off.
stabled.motion_blur.where: Applies to the 3D world only. The HUD, chat and menus stay sharp, and it is not visible on the main menu.
stabled.discord.preview_off: Presence is off for this Save
stabled.discord.preview_label: Preview of the activity card. Discord shows your real activity based on what you are doing in game.
stabled.discord.privacy: Only general activity is shared (in menus, singleplayer, multiplayer or Realms). Server addresses, world names and account details are never sent. Stabled never asks for your Discord password or token.
stabled.discord.status.waiting: Status: Discord is not running or not reachable. Retrying in %ss; the game is unaffected.
stabled.discord.status.rejected: Status: Discord rejected this build's application ID. Presence stays off until it is corrected.
stabled.discord.status.not_configured: Status: not configured. This build of Stabled has no Discord application ID (DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID), so no activity is sent.
stabled.menus.styled: Stabled styling for title and pause menus
stabled.menus.styled.desc: Turn off to use the vanilla look. Stabled Settings stays available from both menus either way. Other game screens always keep the vanilla style.
stabled.menus.replay.desc: Shows the five-step introduction again for this Save.
stabled.menus.launched: Running from the Stabled launcher. Settings on this page belong to this Save; theme and surface style are shared with the launcher.
stabled.menus.dev: Running outside the Stabled launcher (development mode). Settings are stored beside the game directory.
stabled.page.emotes.summary: Hold %s in game, point at an emote and let go. Moving stops it.
stabled.emotes.title: Emotes
stabled.emotes.hint_hold: Let go of %s to play · click · 1–8 · Esc to cancel
stabled.emotes.hint_click: Click an emote · 1–8 · %s or Esc to close
stabled.emotes.third_person: Show me in third person while emoting
stabled.emotes.third_person.desc: The camera turns to face you for the emote, then goes back to first person.
stabled.emotes.local: Emotes are shown on your screen only: servers don't share them with other players.
stabled.emotes.need_world: Join a world to try them.
